arms.v2_real: v2 fitted to the REAL clip (R3, flight_floor_lowk)
arms.v2_legacy_lowk: v2 fitted to the LEGACY render (flight_floor_lowk)
arms.v2_legacy_free: v2 fitted to the LEGACY render (flight, free profile)

frontend.note: constant-Q: the analysis window of the bin at f is Q/f seconds (Q = 1/(2^(1/B)-1)); the -3 dB bandwidth is f/Q Hz. Both are tabulated per order in protocol.window_ms_at_fbar

protocol.floor: headline c_k reads the label's own bin over the INTER-TOOTH floor: the median of the six bins nearest (k -+ 1/2) * f_r. c_k_local is the strict annulus and is NaN above the order where the four-rotor comb stops being resolvable at 48 bins/octave; n_annulus_bins records it
